title: Sidney Desvigne, Earl Bostic and Desvigne's band
summary: He recalls bands rehearsing in houses, hearing Desvigne's band with Earl Bostic as a boy, and later playing with Desvigne.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: He told us about Sidney Desveen's band, or just what it was like when you played with him?

Sidney, yeah, when I, well, as you know, when I was a boy learning how to play music, at that time it was customary for the band to practice in houses at that time, see? And like, I mean, like today you say, well, I go to the union and they got a special place for bands to work. Well, it wasn't like that at that time. Everybody used to practice in the front room, see? Well, Sidney Desveen was living in the next block from my house, but I used to go down there and listen to their band play, and Earl Bostic was playing with Sidney Desveen. When Earl Bostic boys come out of school, that's where he comes from, he comes from Zebby, you know? Zebby, yeah. Yeah. But Sister Letitia taught Earl Bostic. Yeah. And he was playing with Sidney Desveen, see? I used to go down there and listen to them, and, uh...
I mean, did he use all arrangements or did they have, uh...

Well, nah, that, uh, well, I mean, as far, during that time, I didn't know what they were playing, but I mean, I heard the music, you know? I didn't know if they were reading arrangements or orchestrations or just what it was, you see?
When you were with them, did Sidney play much in style or did he play in the record?

Yes, no, Sidney was very active in the section. He played along with everybody else in the section. Well, we played arrangements, we played stocks and everything, you know? And I worked with Sidney a good while. And I made several little trips out of town, like to Morgan City and these little country towns or so like that with Sidney. I played quite a bit with him, right? Yeah, he was all right. Well, I mean, I can't say too much about Sidney. I know he played out on the boat a long time, too, on the steamer captor. Yeah, uh, but that's all, I mean, that's the only contact I ever came in with Sidney Desmond was, uh, when I was working in his band. That's about the only contact I did come in with him, see? Now, uh,
How big a band was the rest of them?
